CLASS:  BTECH   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH: CHEM ENGG   SESSION : SP/2023

SUBJECT: CL227 MATERIALS SCIENCE & ENGG.
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Describe briefly on broad goal of MSE? [2] 1 describe
Q.1(b) Classify  different  hybrid  materials.  Write  are  the  advantages  of  hybrid
materials?
[3] 2 classify


Q.2(a) Explain the role of crystal defects in modification of the properties of the
metal.
[2] 1 explain
Q.2(b) Derive an expression for number of atoms per unit cell and Atomic Packing
Factor in case of Simple cubic, BCC, and FCC.
[3] 2 derive


Q.3(a) Differentiate the crystal structures of the materials affect their processing? [2] 1 differentiate
Q.3(b) Describe the casting techniques of metal? [3] 2 describe


Q.4(a) Describe the various types of reactant solutions used in leaching
process. Give examples of metals extracted by various leaching processes.  
[2] CO1 DESCRIBE
Q.4(b) Compare between pyro, hydro- and electrometallurgy processes in respect to
principle, types, advantages, and limitations of them.
[3] CO3 COMPARE


Q.5(a) Explain  the  demerits  of  carbon  smelting.  How  do  we  overcome  these
limitations?
[2] CO3 EXPLAIN
Q.5(b) Draw the predominance area diagram for Ni ore roasting process in respect of
the various reactions involved. Write down the significance of the PAD for a
specific metal extraction used in industries.
[3] CO1 DRAW
